summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.32/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.32 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 21, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest in WPR's 8 months of tracking. AAA figures put the statewide average 27¢ lower than a week ago, 73¢ lower than a month ago, and 65¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.04) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.79).
